purpose: Test whether more independent training repeats improve Q_param without changing the Study01 parameter domain, network, validation rows, or test rows.
fixed_test: repeat_id < 300 and repeat_id % 5 == fold_idx; 60 per combo
expanded_train: same three training residue classes; repeat_id range expanded only for training
sha256_rule: text files LF-normalized; NPZ binary raw
interpretation: Descriptive screening only. No formal significance claim and no paper-main replacement.
stop_rule: If Q test rRMSE does not improve clearly and monotonically, stop. If it does, confirm only the smallest useful level in a separate frozen run.
